dialogues.speaker: Great Merchant Huang
dialogues.text: Oh ho, are you worried about the meteorites too? Worry no more! As long as you stay by one blessed by the adepti such as myself, you will remain hearty and hale!

dialogues.speaker: Great Merchant Huang
dialogues.text: I am a man of leisure, after all — I will gladly keep you company.

dialogues.speaker: Great Merchant Huang
dialogues.text: Ho, did you come here because you've heard that an adeptus saved me, hoping that my luck might rub off on you?

dialogues.speaker: Great Merchant Huang
dialogues.text: Well, it's fine. It's not as if I had anything else to do. Let's have a chat, then.

dialogues.speaker: Great Merchant Huang
dialogues.text: Some time ago, I picked up a stone that looked an outstretched thumb and little finger!

dialogues.speaker: Great Merchant Huang
dialogues.text: With such a strange shape, it must surely have been a sacred stone, and so, I must be protected by the adepti!

dialogues.speaker: Great Merchant Huang
dialogues.text: Not to mention the fact that since I obtained this mysterious stone, good things follow me wherever I go! This must be what they call "rocks fall, fortunes turn," eh?

dialogues.speaker: Great Merchant Huang
dialogues.text: When you think about it like that, I suppose all those people at the Lantern Rite were celebrating me, then! The same goes for all the people coming to Wangshu Inn. They must all be here for my blessings, no?

dialogues.speaker: Great Merchant Huang
dialogues.text: ...Well then, should you encounter any good fortune in the future, just remember to thank me in your heart.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't you have anything to do?

dialogues.speaker: Great Merchant Huang
dialogues.text: Oh, just talking about it makes my blood boil.

dialogues.speaker: Great Merchant Huang
dialogues.text: Ever since I received the protection of the adepti, I've been doing business on the road between Mondstadt and Liyue, and it was going swimmingly, too!

dialogues.speaker: Great Merchant Huang
dialogues.text: But after a while, someone — I have no idea who, but I'm sure it was someone in our merchant guild jealous of my success — caused the higher-ups to have me posted to Qingce Village!

dialogues.speaker: Great Merchant Huang
dialogues.text: ...Hmph. Even if I were to die here at Wangshu Inn, I would never go to Qingce Village. That destitute backwater would be the death of my talents and fortune!

dialogues.speaker: Great Merchant Huang
dialogues.text: Ho, not even a "thank you"? But a great man must have a great heart. I shall not quarrel with you. No need to thank me!
